subject: After closing the R console with ",rq", Vim goes haywire.

messages.author: d72e57e5f1ad8c13
messages.subject: After closing the R console with ",rq", Vim goes haywire.
parts:
After closing the R console with the command ",rq", Vim goes haywire.

When I try to pass into command mode with the "Escape" key, I get the following output "^[".
The arrow keys also no longer work,
For example, the up arrow gives the following output: "[OA".
Since I cannot pass into command mode, I cannot quit Vim and have to close the terminal.

How can I correct this issue?
Before closing the R console, everything works fine.
Everything also works fine if I close the R console by switching panes, and typing "q()".

  • Tmux 1.9

messages.author: d72e57e5f1ad8c13
messages.subject: Re: After closing the R console with ",rq", Vim goes haywire.
parts:
Here is more information for my setup.

tmux 1.6
Vim 7.4
R: 3.1.0
Desktop: MacOS 10.10.2
Server: CentOS 6.5

I've just tested it at home, after experiencing the problem at work.
I have exactly the same problem.
I can reproduce it every time.

Here is the sequence of commands.

tmux
vim ~/.test.R
,rf
,rq

The Esc, and the arrow keys then no longer act as Esc and arrow keys, while they worked perfectly before sending the command to quit the R console.

Esc: [^
Up Arrow: ^[OA
Down arrow: ^[OB
Left arrow: ^[OD
Right arrow: ^[OC

All the software is up to date, except for tmux, but I'm not sure how that could be the source of the problem.

Thanks for your help.

messages.author: b256a2742aacd200
messages.subject: Re: After closing the R console with ",rq", Vim goes haywire.
parts:
You have to upgrade Tmux. The plugin only works properly with Tmux >= 1.8.

Are you accessing the CentOS server through ssh? Tmux, Vim and R should be ran only in the server.

messages.author: d72e57e5f1ad8c13
messages.subject: Re: After closing the R console with ",rq", Vim goes haywire.
parts:
I was finally able to upgrade tmux.
It did fix the issue.
Thank you for your help.
